before: setHighlights marked text ranges only, and a range could not cover the view-only tags at a control's edges: a veil over a control dimmed its text and left its tags lit.
after: setHighlights takes { controlId } targets beside ranges; a control target paints the control's boundary fragments, tags included, at either level.
reason: Highlights are view state: they never change the document, are never saved, and are not shared with collaborators, so no peer reads them.
